title: 第404章 归来第403章 东来
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 刘锋笑了一下。
“你后面会懂的。”
他说道，语气轻描淡写，仿佛在说一件微不足道的小事。
说罢，他转身便要离去。
“大人且慢！”
叶欣诚急忙开口，一步跨上前去，拦在了刘锋面前，“大人，如今南疆教匪作乱，黑风道十三县已有七县沦陷，府尊大人坐镇府城苦苦支撑，全凭您方才显露神威才稳住局面。
若是您此刻离开，消息一旦传出，只怕那些潜伏的教匪余孽会立刻死灰复燃，届时——”
他话未说完，但意思已经再明白不过。
刘锋闻言，脚步一顿。
他没有立刻回答，而是微微偏头，月光映照下，那双幽潭般的眼眸中闪过一丝了然的光芒。
随即，他轻轻摇头，失笑道：“倒是我疏忽了。这一觉睡得太久，醒来后只顾着处理旧日因果，却忘了眼前这烂摊子还需收拾。”
叶欣诚还没来得及接话，便见刘锋抬起右手，五指张开，凌空一抓。
一道金光自他掌心凝聚，化作一枚古朴的敕令，其上篆刻着蝌蚪般的符文，流转着淡淡的青色光华。
他随手一挥，那敕令便化作一道流光，破空而去，径直没入不远处那座残破的山神庙中。
下一刻，山神庙轰然震动。
一股磅礴浩荡的气息从庙中冲天而起，直贯云霄！
那气息凛冽而清澈，带着河水奔腾的浩瀚之意，又蕴含着斩妖除魔的肃杀之气，瞬间席卷了整个山头。
在场的兵士们只觉得一股清风拂面而过，连日征战的疲惫与恐惧竟一扫而空，精神为之一振。
庙顶之上，一道模糊的身影缓缓凝聚，身披银甲，手持一柄三尖两刃刀，面容英武，眉宇间却透着一股超然的淡漠。
那身影朝刘锋的方向遥遥拱手一礼，随即便化作一道清光，落入庙中，消失不见。
叶欣诚瞠目结舌，半晌才找回自己的声音：“那是……那是……”
“我已经接引清源妙道真君真灵自河中归来。”
刘锋的声音从前方传来，平静而悠远，“他会助你平定南疆教匪之乱。”
叶欣诚猛地转头，却发现刘锋已经走出了十丈之外。那道瘦削的灰布短褂身影在月光下拖出一道长长的影子，正一步步朝着千妖窟的方向走去，步履从容，跛态依旧，却有一种说不出的洒脱与决绝。
风中，他的声音继续传来，越来越远，也越来越淡：
“真君昔年曾受我一桩因果，如今正是偿还之时。有他在，莫说南疆教匪，便是白莲总坛亲至，也动不了你们分毫。”
“叶捕头，保重。”
最后两个字落下时，刘锋的身影已经完全融入了千妖窟洞口的黑暗之中，再也看不见了。
叶欣诚站在原地，望着那个方向，久久无言。
身后，山神庙中那股清冽的气息愈发浓郁，仿佛有一位沉睡了千百年的神明，正在缓缓睁开眼睛。
府城，知府衙门后堂。
content_en:
Liu Feng smiled.
"You'll understand later."
He said in an understatement, as if he was talking about a trivial matter.
After that, he turned around and left.
"Sir, please wait!"
Ye Xincheng spoke hurriedly, stepped forward and stopped in front of Liu Feng, "Sir, the religious bandits are now in chaos in southern Xinjiang, and seven of the thirteen counties of Heifeng Road have fallen. Lord Fu Zun is in charge of the city and struggling to support it. It is all because of your power that you have just shown to stabilize the situation.
If you leave now, once the news gets out, I'm afraid those lurking remnants of the cult bandits will immediately resurface, and then--"
He didn't finish his words, but his meaning was clear enough.
Liu Feng paused when he heard this.
He did not answer immediately, but tilted his head slightly. Under the moonlight, a glimmer of understanding flashed in his pool-like eyes.
Immediately, he shook his head slightly and said with a smile: "I was negligent. I slept for too long. When I woke up, I only focused on dealing with the old cause and effect, but I forgot that the mess in front of me still needs to be cleaned up."
Before Ye Xincheng could answer, he saw Liu Feng raise his right hand, spread his fingers, and grab it in the air.
A ray of golden light condensed from his palm and turned into a simple edict, with tadpole-like runes engraved on it and a faint cyan brilliance flowing around it.
He waved his hand casually, and the edict turned into a stream of light, shot through the air, and disappeared directly into the dilapidated mountain temple not far away.
The next moment, the mountain temple shook violently.
A majestic aura soared from the temple and penetrated into the sky!
The breath was sharp and clear, carrying the immensity of the rushing river and the chilling aura of slaying demons. It swept across the entire mountain in an instant.
The soldiers present felt a breeze blowing across their faces. The fatigue and fear of days of fighting were swept away, and their spirits were lifted.
On the top of the temple, a vague figure slowly gathered, wearing silver armor and holding a three-pointed two-edged sword. His face was heroic, but there was a detached indifference between his brows.
The figure bowed its hands in the direction of Liu Feng, then turned into a ray of light, fell into the temple, and disappeared.
Ye Xincheng was stunned, and it took him a while to find his voice: "That's... that's..."
"I have led the spirit of Qingyuan Miao Dao Zhenjun back from the river."
Liu Feng's voice came from the front, calm and distant, "He will help you put down the rebellion of the religious bandits in southern Xinjiang."
Ye Xincheng turned his head suddenly, only to find that Liu Feng had already walked ten feet away. The thin figure in a short gray cloth coat dragged out a long shadow in the moonlight, walking step by step in the direction of Thousand Monsters Cave. His steps were calm and his limp was still the same, but he had an indescribable sense of freedom and determination.
In the wind, his voice continued to come, getting farther and farther and getting fainter:
"The True Lord suffered some karma from me in the past, and now is the time to repay it. As long as he is here, not to mention the Southern Xinjiang religious bandits, even if the White Lotus General Altar comes personally, he will not be able to touch you in the slightest."
"Ye Captou, take care."
When the last two words fell, Liu Feng's figure had completely blended into the darkness at the entrance of Thousand Demons Cave and was no longer visible.
Ye Xincheng stood there, looking in that direction, speechless for a long time.
Behind him, the crisp atmosphere in the mountain temple became stronger and stronger, as if a god who had been sleeping for thousands of years was slowly opening his eyes.
Fucheng, the back hall of the magistrate's office.
